name: Connect Contact Form 7 and AWeber
author: Renzo Johnson

sections.description:
Connect Contact Form 7 and AWeber allows you to automatically add form submissions to your AWeber mailing lists using the latest AWeber API. This extension supports multiple mailing lists and API keys, making it easy to manage your email marketing directly from your WordPress forms.

Whether you’re building your newsletter audience or capturing leads, this plugin bridges the gap between your Contact Form 7 forms and your AWeber account.

Key Features

  • Easy setup and configuration
  • Use different mailing lists for each contact form
  • Single opt-in (no confirmation email)
  • Double opt-in (confirmation email sent to subscribers)
  • Optional opt-in checkbox for GDPR compliance
  • Support for AWeber custom fields
  • Latest AWeber API integration
  • Regular updates and maintenance

Coming Soon

  • Support for AWeber groups
  • Support for AWeber segments

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.4 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 5.0 or higher
  • An active AWeber account

Documentation

For setup instructions and detailed documentation, visit the plugin documentation.

Support

Need help? Visit our support page to get assistance.

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to the AWeber API to manage your email subscribers. When a form is submitted, subscriber data (email, name, and any mapped custom fields) is sent to AWeber’s servers.

  • AWeber Service: https://www.aweber.com
  • AWeber Terms of Service: https://www.aweber.com/terms-of-service.htm
  • AWeber Privacy Policy: https://www.aweber.com/privacy.htm

By using this plugin, you agree to AWeber’s terms of service and privacy policy.

Disclaimer

This plugin is developed and maintained independently. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to AWeber Communications, Inc. or the Contact Form 7 development team. “AWeber” is a registered trademark of AWeber Communications, Inc. “Contact Form 7” is developed by Takayuki Miyoshi.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Connect Contact Form 7 and AWeber”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the entire integrate-contact-form-7-and-aweber folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress

Configuration

After activation, edit any Contact Form 7 form and navigate to the “AWeber” tab to configure your API credentials and select your mailing list.

For detailed setup instructions, visit the documentation.
sections.faq:
How do I get my AWeber API credentials?

You’ll need to authorize the plugin with your AWeber account. Visit the AWeber tab in your Contact Form 7 form editor and follow the authorization process. For step-by-step instructions, see our authorization guide.

Can I use different mailing lists for different forms?

Yes, each Contact Form 7 form can be connected to a different AWeber mailing list. Simply configure the AWeber settings individually for each form.

Does this plugin support custom fields?

Yes, you can map your Contact Form 7 fields to AWeber custom fields. This allows you to capture additional subscriber information beyond just email and name.

What is the difference between single and double opt-in?

Single opt-in adds subscribers directly to your list without requiring email confirmation. Double opt-in sends a confirmation email that subscribers must click before being added to your list. Double opt-in is recommended for GDPR compliance and better list quality.

How do I add an opt-in checkbox to my form?

You can add an optional checkbox that allows visitors to choose whether they want to subscribe. See our opt-in checkbox guide for instructions.

The plugin isn’t working. How do I troubleshoot?

First, ensure your AWeber API credentials are correctly configured. Check that your Contact Form 7 form has the email field properly mapped. If issues persist, visit our support page for assistance.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin provides tools to help with GDPR compliance, including an optional opt-in checkbox. However, GDPR compliance depends on how you configure and use the plugin. Consult with a legal professional for specific compliance requirements.
